entries.title: Official MCP Registry — registry.modelcontextprotocol.io
entries.note: Official Anthropic-stewarded registry; preview launched September 2025, ~2,000 entries in months.

entries.title: The MCP Registry — overview
entries.note: Distinguishes Official Registry vs. Generic Registry API (OpenAPI spec reusable by anyone).

entries.title: MCP Registry OpenAPI 3.1 spec (openapi.yaml)
entries.note: Authoritative OpenAPI for the registry; JSON-Schema draft 2020-12; $id 2025-09-29/server-registry-openapi.

entries.title: Generic MCP Registry API reference
entries.note: Reusable API spec any third-party registry can implement: GET /v0.1/servers, /versions, pagination, etc.

entries.title: Introducing the MCP Registry (preview)
entries.note: September 2025 announcement of the official registry preview.

entries.title: server.json format specification
entries.note: Canonical manifest schema: name, version, packages[], remotes[], transport, env. Hosted at static.modelcontextprotocol.io/schemas/2025-10-17/server.schema.json.

entries.title: Quickstart — Publish an MCP server to the registry
entries.note: mcp-publisher CLI, GitHub auth for io.github.<user>/* namespaces, npm mcpName / PyPI README binding.

entries.title: Meet the GitHub MCP Registry
entries.note: GitHub's curated entry-point for MCP server discovery, each entry backed by a GitHub repo.

entries.title: GitHub topic — mcp-server
entries.note: 16,312 repos tagged as of May 2026; Python ~5.7k, TypeScript ~5.1k, JavaScript ~1.7k.

entries.title: MCP.so — community directory
entries.note: Community-led directory; >20,000 servers via PR/issue submissions; no programmatic install, no curation tier.

entries.title: Smithery — MCP server registry
entries.note: ~7,000 servers; semantic-search registry API, CLI install (smithery mcp search/add), hosted remote-server option.

entries.title: Smithery Registry — Search Servers (API docs)
entries.note: REST API surface; semantic search treats query as a prompt; requires API key from smithery.ai/account/api-keys.

entries.title: Smithery CLI — install/manage MCP servers
entries.note: npm install -g @smithery/cli; smithery mcp search / smithery mcp add <url>.

entries.title: Awesome MCP Servers — mcpservers.org
entries.note: Curated awesome-list-style directory; manual review; data hosted as flat pages.

entries.title: Glama — MCP server registry
entries.note: ~24,000 servers; deep per-connector scanning (tool names, schemas, licenses, quality scores).

entries.title: PulseMCP server directory
entries.note: ~15,000 hand-reviewed servers; daily updates; quality-filtered discovery.

entries.title: modelcontextprotocol/servers — reference & community servers
entries.note: Reference servers maintained by Anthropic + community submissions list.

entries.title: Docker MCP Catalog & Toolkit
entries.note: 300+ verified servers as signed Docker images; OCI-artifact custom catalogs for orgs.

entries.title: docker/mcp-registry — Official Docker MCP registry
entries.note: PR-based onboarding; servers ship within 24h of approval to Docker Desktop MCP Toolkit.

entries.title: MCP supply-chain crisis — 40+ CVEs in early 2026
entries.note: 40+ CVEs Jan–Apr 2026 across SDKs/marketplaces; 9 of 11 MCP marketplaces affected. Recommends signed sources + sandboxing.

entries.title: Anthropic MCP design vulnerability enables RCE
entries.note: STDIO process-spawn semantics let a malicious command execute even on launch failure; ~200k vulnerable instances.

entries.title: Cargo — Alternative Registries
entries.note: [registries] table in .cargo/config.toml; --registry flag; auth tokens per registry.

entries.title: Cargo — Source Replacement
entries.note: [source.crates-io] replace-with = '<name>'; full-registry mirroring pattern.

entries.title: Homebrew — Taps (Third-Party Repositories)
entries.note: brew tap <user>/<repo> [URL]; any git repo works; auto-update on brew update.

entries.title: mise — Plugins and registries
entries.note: First-party registry + mise-plugins org for community; aqua/github backends preferred over asdf shell scripts for supply-chain reasons.

entries.title: Supply chain security with mise and asdf plugins
entries.note: Why mise now refuses new asdf-style plugins: arbitrary shell on install. Mirrors MCP's STDIO-command risk.

entries.title: Nix — flake registry
entries.note: Global symbolic-name registry; per-user overrides via nix registry add; nixConfig.flake-registry for project-pinned.

entries.title: Debian wiki — DebianRepository/UseThirdParty
entries.note: signed-by= key pinning per repo file; /etc/apt/sources.list.d/ pattern for additive sources.

entries.title: pipx — --index-url support
entries.note: pipx install --index-url for private PyPI mirrors; no --extra-index-url (single-source per invocation).

entries.title: pip search deprecation (PyPI XML-RPC disabled)
entries.note: PyPI XML-RPC search permanently disabled March 2021; cautionary tale for unsustainable registry-side search.

entries.title: npm package provenance (GitHub Blog)
entries.note: Sigstore-keyless provenance attestations on npm; verifiable link from package to source repo + build.

entries.title: sigstore/cosign — signing & verification
entries.note: Keyless signing with Fulcio short-lived certs; Rekor transparency log; signatures stored alongside OCI artifacts.

entries.title: jedisct1/minisign — lightweight signing
entries.note: Single Ed25519 pubkey, single-file signature; signify-compatible; trivial to embed for registry-level signing.

entries.title: Getting Started With the Official MCP Registry API
entries.note: Walks through GET /v0.1/servers, pagination, version subresources.

entries.title: Best MCP Registries in 2026 — comparison
entries.note: Side-by-side comparison of official registry, mcp.so, Smithery, Glama, PulseMCP, Docker.

entries.title: MCP roadmap — enterprise readiness 2026
entries.note: Post-Linux-Foundation roadmap prioritizes enterprise readiness, signing, registry hardening.

entries.title: Donating MCP to the Agentic AI Foundation
entries.note: December 2025: governance transfer to Linux Foundation; registry now vendor-neutral by charter.

entries.title: npm + Sigstore GA — provenance attestations
entries.note: GA status; >500M downloads of provenance-enabled package versions during beta.
